Quantum ESPRESSO

Accelerate Bench task · Molecular simulation & electronic structure

Quantum ESPRESSO calculates electronic states and the density of states of a crystal.

Task version1.3.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory6 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

The workflow runs self-consistent and non-self-consistent calculations with supplied pseudopotentials, extracts the charge density and computes the density of states.

Correctness

The verifier checks physical arrays, aligned wavefunctions, charge density, density of states, convergence and checkpoint recovery.

Timing

Timing covers the initial electronic calculation, density postprocessing, the non-self-consistent calculation and the density-of-states process. Checkpoint recovery is checked separately.

Reported runtime-saving reward

First-run rewards on benchmark v1.1, from the data behind paper Table 1, rounded to one decimal. Failed correctness is distinct from a correct result with zero speedup reward.
